transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [Name]. What brings you in today?

I... um, I came in because I just can't stop feeling like everything that goes wrong is my fault. Like... I'm a bad employee, and a bad homeowner. I just... I feel like I deserve to lose everything I've worked for.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once found pleasurable?

Yeah... I guess so. I used to do a lot more. Like, um... plan brunches, or paint in the spare room... go hiking. Even sign up for networking events. But... I don't know. Now all of that just feels like... like tasks. Like I'm just pretending to care about them.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
I don't know... I guess so. Most days, yeah. I just... I don't really keep track, but I feel pretty down a lot of the time.
Have you been feeling like you’re worthless or felt excessive guilt about things recently?

Yeah... um, I mean, like I said when I first came in. I just... I can't stop thinking that everything going wrong is my fault. That I'm a bad employee, and a bad homeowner... and that I deserve to lose everything I've worked for. So... yeah.
Have you noticed that you've been moving more slowly than usual, or conversely, that you can't sit still and are more restless than usual?

I guess... maybe slower. Um, at work, especially in the mornings. It just... it takes a lot of effort to do anything. Like opening spreadsheets or typing an email... even just walking to a meeting. It feels heavy, like I'm trying to move through wet cement or something. I just... I can't seem to go any faster.
Have you noticed a decrease in your energy levels or felt more fatigued lately, even after getting enough rest?
Um... no, I don't think so. I mean... I'm not really physically tired, I guess. I haven't really noticed being more fatigued... just what I said before.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Um... I guess so. It’s... kind of all over the place. I mostly just skip real meals during the day. I've just been having... coffee, mostly. Or toast. Just whatever is easiest, I guess. And... I mean, I have noticed my clothes are a bit looser. But... yeah.
Have you ever felt so overwhelmed or hopeless that you’ve thought about hurting yourself or that life isn’t worth living?
No... not really. I mean, things are hard, but... no. I haven't thought about that.
How long have you been feeling this way? When did these feelings start?

Um... I guess it's been a while. Maybe... a little over two years? Two years and three months, I think. It kind of started... after I bought my townhouse. Just... the pressure of trying to keep it, I guess. It just sort of built up.
